chunks: From him, from Hammād, from Ḥarīz, from one who informed him, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, that he said:
The hadd punishment is distributed over the whole body, while the private part and the face are avoided, and the striking is to be moderate between the two extremes.

key_terms.الْجَسَدِ: the body over which the punishment is distributed
key_terms.الْفَرْجُ: the private part, which must be avoided
key_terms.الْوَجْهُ: the face, which must be avoided
key_terms.بَيْنَ الضَّرْبَيْنِ: with moderation between two extremes of striking

ai.seo_question: How should the hadd punishment be administered according to Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding how the hadd punishment is to be administered physically. It specifies that the blows are distributed over the body, while avoiding the face and private parts, and that the striking should be of moderate intensity.
